claim: Auberge du Vieux Puits hotel has 12 rooms, 4-star Prestige rating, rates from €310/night, member of Les Collectionneurs.
quote: Number of Rooms: 12 rooms. Star Rating: 4 stars (Prestige Hotel). Price Range: €310 per night without breakfast. The establishment holds membership in Les Collectionneurs group.

claim: Four room categories on the Auberge's own site: Suite Terrasse €490, Junior Suite Terrasse €460, Chambre Terrasse €430, Chambre à la Maison des Chefs €310; all rooms have A/C, minibar, Nespresso, wifi.
quote: Suite Terrasse €490 | Junior Suite Terrasse €460 | Chambre Terrasse €430 | Chambre à la Maison des Chefs €310. All rooms feature air conditioning, minibar, Nespresso machine, bathrobes, LCD TV, free Wi-Fi, Italian shower, and hairdryer.

claim: Auberge is on Avenue Saint-Victor, 11360 Fontjoncouse; 2026 season runs 20 March – 29 November; breakfast €40; closed Mondays, Tuesdays and Sunday evenings.
quote: Location: Avenue Saint Victor, 11360 Fontjoncouse, Aude. Opening Period: March 20 – November 29, 2026 (closed Mondays, Tuesdays, and Sunday evenings). Breakfast: €40.

claim: Auberge hotel scores 4.6/5 over 341 TripAdvisor reviews; reception is inside the Michelin-starred restaurant; pool is unheated; guests warn that driving away after dinner on dark, hilly roads would be foolish, and that the in-village rooms are 'a bit too far for a post dinner stroll in the dark'.
quote: 4.0-star classification, 8 rooms, 4.6/5 overall rating from 341 Tripadvisor reviews. 'reception is at the Michelin-starred restaurant'. Pool 'was not heated'. 'one would have to be an utter fool to leave the restaurant late at night and attempt to drive anywhere on those hilly and curvy, narrow roads'. 'the rooms in the center of the village are in my opinion a bit too far for a post dinner stroll in the dark'.

claim: The Auberge's Maison des Chefs annex sits at 1 Rue de l'Église in the old village core, reached on foot via the lavoir (wash-house) footpath in about 5 minutes from the restaurant.
quote: 1 Rue de l'Église in Fontjoncouse, within the village center. Accessible either by car with parking, or on foot through walking paths in 5 minutes. Just a few steps away from the Restaurant via the small path of the lavoir.

claim: Le Petit Clos offers three independent accommodations (Cinsault room, Carignan room in former wine cellars, and a self-catering gîte), all king-size, all €94/night for two with breakfast included.
quote: Cinsault Room - Ground-floor bedroom with independent entrance. Carignan Room - Independent entry showcasing the property's historic wine cellars. Gîte - Fully independent small apartment with private terrace. All three options accommodate 1-2 people at €94/night.

claim: Le Petit Clos is at 19 avenue Saint-Victor, roughly a one-minute walk to the Auberge, rated 4.5/5 over 63 reviews, hosted by Isabelle and José; breakfast and parking are included.
quote: Address: 19 avenue Saint-Victor, 11360 Fontjoncouse, France. Distance to Auberge du Vieux Puits: Approximately 1 minute walk (described as 'just around the corner'). Star rating: 4.5 of 5 bubbles. Total reviews: 63. Hosts: Isabelle, José.

claim: Le Petit Clos street-level distance figure: described as 50 metres from l'Auberge du Vieux Puits.
quote: Le Petit Clos is located 50 meters from 'l'Auberge du Vieux Puits'.

claim: MaCoCo (Maison Coeur Corbières) is at Rue de la Vignolle 17, Fontjoncouse; three double rooms from €115/night, hosted by Truitje and Peter, adults-only (18+), with a salt-water pool and outdoor kitchen.
quote: Rue de la Vignolle 17, 11360 Fontjoncouse. Three double rooms total. €115 per night. Hosts: Truitje & Peter. The establishment focuses on adults (18+). salt-water pool. outdoor pool, pool house, outdoor kitchen, several terraces.

claim: MaCoCo guest review notes it is 'one minute on foot' from the Auberge du Vieux Puits.
quote: one review mentions it is '1 minute à pied' (1 minute walk away).

claim: Gîte Lithosol at Domaine Femenias is at 17 avenue Saint-Victor, sleeping 2, on the ground floor of a master house 'at the entrance of the village, 30 m to the right of the restaurant'; weekly rates €280–€405.
quote: 17 avenue Saint-Victor, 11360 Fontjoncouse. At the entrance of the village, passing in front of the restaurant, the gîte is 30 m to the right. Weekly rates (furnished) range from €280.00 to €405.00. Capacity: 2 places.

claim: An Airbnb chambre d'hôte in a converted 'anciens chais' (old wine-cellar) winegrower's house sleeps four with shared pool, marketed as 50 m from the 3-star restaurant.
quote: Chambre 4P dans anciens chais — Calme, piscine, Confortable maison vigneronne dans village typique des Corbières à 50m. d'un célèbre restaurant 3***.

claim: Fontjoncouse has roughly 127 inhabitants over 27.35 km² — every lodging listed here sits inside the same compact village core.
quote: Fontjoncouse has a population of 127 inhabitants. Area 27.35 km², population density 4.90 inhabitants/km².

claim: Taxi service is bookable from Fontjoncouse for transfers to stations and airports (Carcassonne ~90 km, Narbonne ~35 km), useful as a fallback when the in-village beds are full.
quote: Taxis in Fontjoncouse offer transfers to stations and airports, local and interurban trips, and long-distance transport on reservation.

claim: Eight pool-side rooms ring the Auberge's swimming pool each with a private terrace; the four Maison des Chefs rooms are in a separate building.
quote: Chef Gilles Goujon and Marie-Christine manage the three-Michelin-starred restaurant and a small hotel with 12 rooms split between two buildings. Eight rooms circle a swimming pool, each with a private terrace, and four more fill the Maison des Chefs.
